query:
UPDATE watch_patterns SET
            callback_url = $2,
            patterns = $3,
            media_want = $4,
            match_targets = $5,
            match_mode = $6,
            min_score = $7,
            media_type_id = $8,
            auto_download = $9,
            metadata = $10,
            enabled = $11,
            upgrade_allowed = $12,
            search_not_before = $13,
            updated_at = NOW()
        WHERE id = $1
